entry.title: New: Resolution 508 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Council: Adopts Res. 508-26 - 04/08/26
entry.content:
TRANSFERS/APPROPRIATES AN APPROPRIATION OUT AND FROM A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT AND CREDITS SAME TO A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT TO PROVIDE A GRANT TO HOSPICE OF HILO FOR EXPENSES RELATED TO ITS 22ND ANNUAL CELEBRATION OF LIFE

Transfers $3,040 from the Clerk-Council Services – Contingency Relief account (Council District 2)
